  Question 1/2 (2 unanswered)
  The legacy billing tables still hold about 40 million rows and the new
  schema splits invoices from payments; how should we migrate the existing
  data before the cutover next week?

  ❯ 1. Online dual-write backfill (Recommended)  Write to both schemas,
                                                 backfill history in batches,
                                                 then switch reads once
                                                 checksums match
    2. Offline dump and restore                  Stop writes for a maintenance
                                                 window, dump, transform and
                                                 restore in one go
    3. Lazy migrate on read                      Convert rows the first time
                                                 they are touched and leave
                                                 cold data in the old tables
    4. None of the above                         Optionally, add details in
                                                 notes (tab).

  esc interrupt
